capabilities: Look up Japanese words by hovering while holding a trigger key
Import Yomitan dictionary zip files such as JMDict or Jitendex
Deinflect conjugated verbs and adjectives before lookup
Toggle the scanner on and off from settings
Delete imported dictionaries to free disk space
extras: Desktop only; the README warns it relies on Node.js and Electron APIs and will not work on Obsidian Mobile (iOS/Android).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up Japanese words in notes, and online dictionaries require a connection and don't handle conjugated forms.

relations.evidence: Yomitan/Yomichan Compatible: Supports Yomitan dictionary formats (JMdict, Jitendex, etc.).

summary: Offline Japanese popup dictionary that shows definitions when hovering over words, using Yomitan-format dictionaries stored locally in IndexedDB.
